data.narrative:
Virtus Solis is a seed-stage company in the Climate & Energy sector that has raised $5.2M to date. The valuation universe includes one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers in the broader sector, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the Climate & Energy sector (zero peers meeting narrow filtering criteria), peer-median valuation was not applicable. The primary method employed was stage-progression analysis, which applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage transitions. Using the $5.2M total raised as a valuation proxy, this method yields $13M.

The triangulated valuation range is $11M to $15M, with a median of $13M. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single applicable method. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct peer comparable data at the seed stage—any valuation within this range is contingent on the validity of the 2.5x multiplier assumption for this specific sector and founder team. Additional datapoints from closer-stage peer financings or market developments would refine this estimate materially.
